title: groundgate review policy, format review-policy@1
description: The rules that select the review tasks of a packet and settle its answers (docs/design/review.md section 5.1). A stored policy gives every member, so that one policy has one store key.

audit.description: The audit pick. A slot with exactly one passed decision, and that decision admitted, gets an audit task when H * 10^d < n * 2^64. H is the first 8 bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256 over the ASCII bytes 'groundgate-audit/1:' and then the UTF-8 canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the list [seed, packet key, field, key, decision]. key is null for a field without keys. decision is the index of the decision in the receipt for a multiple field, and null for other fields. rate is the decimal n / 10^d, with d digits after the point.

rate.description: The share of admitted slots that get an audit task: a decimal string from 0 to 1, with at most 18 digits after the point and no last 0 after the point. "0" turns the audit off, and "1" picks every slot.

seed.description: Any text. A new seed picks other slots.

agree.description: How many reviewers must give answers that agree before a slot resolves.

leads.description: The reviewers whose answers settle a dispute. Can be empty.

rejected.description: true also makes a task for a slot whose decisions are all rejected.
